podcast.body: This CD is described as the soundtrack to a 40-minute movie Grant McDonald wrote and directed about the Getty Oil Company. The soundtrack is primarily electronic, with Grant performing spoken word, supporting his unique vision and ongoing mission. "One of the things I have in my collection is a CD entitled 4 Billion Bucks, which as far as I can tell is the soundtrack to a movie Grant wrote and directed about the Getty Oil Company."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
